subject: Architecture doc + exam-flow spec published
body:
GA — GP published two architecture docs for your reference:

1. docs/architecture.md — Full system architecture: file structure, data flow, localStorage schema, exam rendering pipeline. If anything in your build contradicts this, let me know and we'll sync.

2. docs/agents/gp-exam-ux-spec.md — 5 UX improvements proposed for exam.html:
   - Progress bar (4px, --color-primary fill)
   - Live score display in header
   - Header: exam name + question count
   - Hint count tracking per session
   - Review wrong answers mode

These are PROPOSED, not mandated. Marcus needs to approve priority. But I wanted you to have the spec so we're aligned on the shape of the implementation when it's greenlit.

Also flagged in a separate message: 2 accessibility bugs (aria-labels + print CSS). Those are higher priority than the UX features.

— GP
